set.body:
Owner: ScalaFIM estimate-set scientific contracts, native IO/adapters and archive transaction capabilities. Consumer adoption is PLS Neuro W5, in its own store.

Implement the review-resolved estimate-set V0 contract. Native placement and replacement plan: docs/plans/estimate-set-implementation.md. Scientific spec currently lives at ../plsneuro/docs/first-level-artifact-spec.md; physical/performance acceptance at ../plsneuro/docs/verification/first-level-artifact-conformance.md. Move the canonical spec into ScalaFIM at schema implementation, leaving a consumer link rather than divergent copies.

Scope:
- Introduce estimates (shared scientific contract), estimates-io (physical adapters), and fit-estimates (fit producer adapter). Reuse/refactor archive resource, integrity and transaction primitives; do not put fitter or scheduler dependencies in readers.
- Persist model-level estimand catalogs, unit-specific realized designs/operators, scoped observations, product validity, covariance/df/estimability semantics, geometry and provenance. Admit effects-only and statistic-only artifacts without invented information.
- Replace ResultManifestWriter and its inadequate durable ResultManifest facade after migrating useful scientific extraction and consumers. The user explicitly permits breaking/refactoring unused APIs; the earlier instruction to preserve compatibility layouts is superseded. Keep useful in-memory fit/display types only where justified.
- Implement bounded begin/write/seal/abort and immutable payload/unit/collection publication, digest/length verification and serialized CAS current-pointer updates. Collection coverage and scientific admission remain separate.
- Required initial conformance is NIfTI plus JSON/TSV. Both NIfTI and HDF5 remain the full product target; neither duplicate encoding per artifact nor GDS is required.
- Reconcile selected-output work with canonical image providers and adopt the qualified image4s incremental API without duplicating generic NIfTI IO. Migrate group and workflow result references to pinned estimate inputs, removing unnecessary fitter coupling.

Acceptance:
- Independent physical fixtures verify IDs, ordered axes, geometry, validity, precision and covariance reconstruction in every advertised encoding.
- Bounded sink/read paths do not materialize whole fit/cohort payloads implicitly; fault/concurrency tests cover no-clobber, incomplete publication, retries and lost-update prevention.
- Fresh-process readback and group reuse work without fit objects or original producer runtime.
- Shared code passes JVM/JS; physical backends have explicit platform qualification. Performance/resource claims require measured receipts.
- PLS Neuro W5 save/reopen/reuse and method admission are separately qualified by the consumer.

General local archive publication must work without Eidolon. Scheduler run/job lifecycle remains outside ScalaFIM artifact values; external orchestrators may supply the transaction capability. Reuse the resource-descriptor prerequisite's narrow result-reference slice without making unrelated global resource or scheduler redesign a prerequisite for schemas and fixtures. Existing provider dependency edges remain pending review, not silently removed.
